given.note: S11-52: Sam signs in on the owner portal by the email way and types his email. The server finds his account on the runtime side (K-09 v1 proof-code-email.json: forPersonId person-sam, caller.personId null), and the code goes to his proven email on file, never back to the page. The answer would be the same if no account matched (S13-45), and the page names the way the code went: email. The address is on the reserved .example domain.
